insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Vi is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Vi in 21/61 games (34%): 7 picks (3-4) and 14 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Azir? They go Ahri
insights.text: Azir is a G1 favorite (6/20 G1s, played by Saint). In the 21 later games where it was burned or banned, Saint went to Ahri (4/21) and Akali (4/21).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 21 G3+ games, 44/105 picks (42%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 43 champs in G1s, 61 in G3+.
